pageProps.title: The Tragedy of Y
pageProps.review: Through Ellery Queen's masterpiece, considered one of the world's top three mystery novels, we convey the meticulous reasoning of great detective Drury Lane, a shocking twist, and deep insights into the method of case resolution.
pageProps.content:
## Review It is one of the ```world's top three mystery novels```. It's a very famous work, but I hadn't picked it up for a while until I happened to see it at Aladin Secondhand Bookstore and decided to read it.
The direction the case flows and the detective's reasoning are not forced and are convincing. Also, the identity of the culprit in the twist and the method used by detective Drury Lane to solve it must have garnered a lot of favor from readers.
But on the other hand, I wonder, "Is it right for the case to be handled like this?" A handling method similar to ```Murder on the Orient Express```.
It's similar to Crooked House.
